_comment: MusePi OTA manifest (Electron updater.cjs + daemon updates.check read this). Channel: this exact file is attached as an ASSET named update-manifest.json to each GitHub release — /releases/latest/download/update-manifest.json redirects to the newest copy (BitFun parity, no API rate limit). At each release: bump version, set url (direct download of the packaged app) + bilingual notes {zh,en}, and upload the file with the release assets.

notes.zh:
- Windows 安装器升级（NSIS assisted，可自定义目录、逐用户免管理员）
- OTA 重启更新（下载更新 → 进度条 → 立即重启）
- 右侧面板 Phase 1：surface 分组 + rail 溢出菜单
- 移动端 MusePi（Android 远程会话伴侣）
- collab 远程会话管理 + 分支（/btw、branchAt 撤回）
